items.title: Make zero-gap API parity an exact bidirectional claim
items.premise: The parity script reports 139 browser calls, 111 contracts, and zero adapter gaps while localApiRuntime implements two undeclared adapter-only routes: GET /api/storage/estimate and GET /api/injuries/active. Neither has a browser caller, manifest contract, nor server implementation.
evidence: scripts/check-api-contract-parity.mjs checks missing declared routes but never unexpected adapter routes
src/app/api/localApiRuntime.js contains the two local-only handlers
repository search finds no other call or contract for either route
the current green summary therefore overstates parity

L1.recipe: Delete the two unreachable local-only handlers.

L2.recipe: Teach parity to fail on unexpected local/server routes, support a frozen explicit adapter-only allowlist with reasons, delete the two unreachable ghosts, expose exact local/server counts, and add fixture tests proving both missing and unexpected routes fail.

L3.recipe: Move transport-neutral handlers behind the contract manifest while keeping persistence translation at adapter edges.

verification: unexpected adapter routes fail the gate
the two ghost routes are absent
declared browser/server/local surfaces join exactly
summary counts are derived from scanned sets

items.title: Route current intent without historical or agent-family contamination
items.premise: The current project-local Codex execution arc is classified FOUNDER because detect-session-mode scans historical handoff/task-board text and all old cross-project references. It then prints Claude-only 'prefers sonnet' and an Opus tier against a codex-1m session.
evidence: live /start output was FOUNDER 6 / BUILDER 2 despite a single-repo implementation mission
detect-session-mode slices raw handoff/task-board history instead of using the newer current-intent source ledger
crossProjectRefs scans the entire append-only task board
model recommendations and prose are hard-coded to Claude model names

L1.recipe: Use latest intent/current open tasks for founder-vs-builder scoring.

L2.recipe: Share the current-intent/task source ledger with session-mode scoring, make agent identity explicit from the session lock, suppress incompatible model-family recommendations, emit explainable evidence, and cover historical-noise plus Codex/Claude cases.

L3.recipe: Move agent-family routing policies into a generated cross-agent manifest owned by Studio Ops.

verification: the current mission classifies builder/execution
historical task-board references cannot flip mode
Codex output contains no Claude-only model directive
Claude behavior remains explicitly covered

items.title: Make ContractService expose only its delegated production authority
items.premise: Session 56 claimed the service bundle contains only characterized delegated authorities, but ContractService still exposes release, restructure, tag, option, and rollover mutations that GameSession does not delegate through. The manifest marks the whole service delegated based on getCapSummary alone.
evidence: SERVICE_AUTHORITY_MANIFEST lists only GameSession.getCapSummary for contracts
ContractService exports five additional public mutation methods
its own file comment says GameSession still owns those production mutations
the current service-authority test checks class presence, not exact public method surface

L1.recipe: Remove undelegated public methods and stale imports.

L2.recipe: Reduce ContractService to the exact cap-summary authority, declare method-level call sites in a frozen manifest, add reflection/static guards for unexpected public methods, and update comments to forbid scaffold methods before characterization.

L3.recipe: Characterize and delegate the next contract mutation atomically with response and mutation parity receipts.

verification: ContractService has only constructor and getCapSummary as public production methods
manifest names exact methods and call sites
guard fails on a future undelegated method
cap summary behavior is unchanged

items.title: Reward deliberate tactical identity and evidenced adaptation, not tactic churn
items.premise: Architect Identity adds up to five mastery points for distinct tactic IDs while Architecture Signal defines consistency as identity. Random tactic churn can therefore outscore a coherent declared philosophy even though the UI teaches reinforcement or a reasoned counter.
evidence: architectMasteryPortfolio scores Math.min(5, tacticIds.size * 1.25)
franchiseArchitecture describes dominant-tactic consistency as the identity signal
ledger entries already contain alignment and nextAdaptation receipts
current tests do not compare random churn with coherent or adaptive histories

L1.recipe: Remove the distinct-tactic reward and clarify evidence copy.

L2.recipe: Add a pure identity evidence model that scores declared continuity plus source-observed reinforce/counter adaptation after film misalignment, exposes a transparent breakdown in the existing Mastery card, and proves random churn cannot beat deliberate identity.

L3.recipe: Add matchup-tagged adaptation arcs across a season without causal win claims.

verification: random tactic variety earns no automatic mastery
consistent intent and evidenced adaptation are distinct explainable components
all scores remain bounded and source-derived
the browser-visible mastery evidence names the rule

It does not name the current chapter, completed transition, or next source-derived milestone.
evidence: franchiseArchitecture.seasonLane reads only openingContractProgress and owner expectation
simulation checkpoints already identify week 5, trade-deadline, postseason, and commitment transitions
season arcs and epilogue already expose source events
adding another retention system was rejected; composition is the bounded gap

L1.recipe: Add a pure current-chapter label to the Season horizon.

L2.recipe: Create a versioned season-chapter composer from phase/week, Opening Contract, owner promise, deadline, playoff, and epilogue receipts; surface one active promise and one next call in Week Room and Return Digest; add transition, empty-state, mobile, and browser-wiring tests.

L3.recipe: Persist a compact chapter archive for long careers and season-to-season recall.

verification: chapter state derives only from live dashboard receipts
exactly one active chapter and next call render
week/phase transitions are deterministic
no new telemetry or reward currency is introduced

L2.recipe: Add a deterministic first-session Playwright journey from setup through all tutorial choices, applied Opening Contract, decision-first weekly plan, committed week, debrief/ledger, and chapter transition; assert zero silent skip and preserve separate skip coverage.
